name: phro-learn
description: Collect the AI and IT terms you meet while working with Claude: phro-learn picks them from Claude's answers into a desktop pane with a short meaning, its kind and the sentence it was met in, judging new candidates in batches to spend few tokens, or, once connected with /phro-learn login, sending only the candidate words to the phrolearn.com service, which judges them with no model call on your side.

language.title: Language of your terms
language.description: The language your terms are collected and explained in on phrolearn.com (ko, en, ja, de, es, fr, pt). "account" keeps the language your phrolearn.com account already has.
